known_outcome: Council answer (leakage): the Council cannot make a determination on or approve specific products; the local jurisdiction must decide whether the product's alternate testing procedure is equivalent to the federal test required by R303.1.4 (16 CFR Part 460); the answer says the product's modified ASTM C518 test with an air gap and reflectivity appears not to be allowed for R-value claims under 16 CFR 460.
review_focus: product-specific approval is outside the Council's role; the local jurisdiction decides
equivalence of an alternate test procedure to the required federal test
test-method modifications that affect a claimed R-value
